column1: Description
Ensembl Gene ID
Type of the primary RNA generated from the gene

Location of the gene in the human hg38 genome linked to the UCSC genome browser. The UCSC link contains transcription factor binding information (ChIP-seq tracks and motif tracks) and a summary thereof (peak-of-peak denotes the summary of peaks identified in the respective ChIP-seq datasets)

Summary of the 57 p53 gene expression profiling datasets. Reflects the number of datasets that identify a gene as significantly up-regulated minus the number of datasets that identify the gene as significantly down-regulated. Range -55 to +57.
The median log2 fold-change observed in the 57 p53 gene expression profiling datasets.

A p53 binding site that is supported by at least five p53 ChIP-seq datasets (see UCSC link for detailed information) is located within 2.5 kb of any of the transcription start sites (TSS) annotated for the gene.

A p53 binding site that is supported by at least five p53 ChIP-seq datasets (see UCSC link for detailed information) is located in an enhancer that is linked to the gene. Based on double-elite enhancer:gene associations from GeneHancer.
The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the transcription factor and tumor suppressor RFX7. p53 activates RFX7 to expand the p53 transcriptional program.
The Cell Cycle Expression Score reflects the number of datasets that identified the gene as being expressed in an oscillating pattern through the cell cycle. Range 0 to 9.

Cell cycle genes are categorized as G1/S or G2/M, reflecting the two major waves of cell cycle-dependent gene expression during the cell cycle. Therefore, peak phases identified by the individual datasets (see below section ‘cell cycle-dependent gene regulation’) were summarized. ‘G1’, ‘G1/S’, and ‘S’ were jointly considered as ‘G1/S’, while ‘G2’, ‘G2/M’, ‘M’, and ‘M/G1’ were jointly considered as ‘G2/M’. Category information is displayed for all genes that were identified as cell cycle genes in at least three datasets. Categorization is based on a majority vote by the datasets, and a draw is designated as ‘UNCLEAR’.

The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the trans-repressor complex DREAM. The complex is known to repress cell cycle genes during G0 and G1 phases as well as in response to p53 signaling.
The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the trans-activator complex MMB:FOXM1. The complex is known to activate cell cycle genes during G2 and M phases.

The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the trans-repressor complex RB:E2F. The complex is known to repress cell cycle genes during G0 and G1 phases as well as in response to p53 signaling.

Summary of 16 deltaNp63 gene expression profiling datasets. Reflects the number of datasets that identify a gene as significantly up-regulated minus the number of datasets that identify the gene as significantly down-regulated. Range -12 to +14.
The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of the p53 sibling and oncogenic transcription factor deltaNp63.
The gene has been identified as a potential direct target of the p53 sibling and oncogenic transcription factor deltaNp63.
UniProt / SwissProt ID

Summary of the five p53 protein expression profiling datasets. Reflects the number of datasets that identify a protein as significantly up-regulated minus the number of datasets that identify the protein as significantly down-regulated. Range -5 to +5.
The median log2 fold-change observed in the five p53 protein expression profiling datasets.

Mouse Gene Symbol

The gene has been identified as a high probability direct target of mouse p53.
